Bill.BriefDescription: Designating coffee as the state beverage.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating coffee as the state beverage; addinga new section to chapter 1.20 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that Washington iswell known as the espresso capital of the country and that the coffeeindustry is a vital part of the Washington state economy.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Coffee is designated as the official beverage of the state ofWashington.
